goal: Diagnose frozen PVC12 quality loss and improve automation vs symmetrically tuned manual; no promised positive outcome
authorization: User explicitly requested improve automation; prior overall no-limit preference retained; local GPU/data/code/docs only; no remote/paid/submission

development.known_v1_final: 2020-09-16 historical evidence only, not reused as pristine test

prefix_diagnostic.interpretation: fixed earlier ranking on both weeks; width diagnostic, not refreshed fold-specific selector
prefix_diagnostic.winner: max minimum weekly delta, then max mean delta, then fewer added features, then name ASC

group_fallback.eligibility: strictly positive marginal MAP on BOTH weeks vs current bundle
group_fallback.winner: max minimum weekly marginal delta, then mean marginal delta, then fewer features, then name ASC
group_fallback.widths: 11 or12 features per group after exactM dedup; two groups22to24; no equal-width claim
group_fallback.zero_fallback: reuse exact M predictions/models; no separate stochastic empty-expansion fit

regularization.trigger: ALWAYS if nonempty expansion selected; skip otherwise
regularization.tuning: each arm choose L2 maximizing mean weekly conditional MAP; ties lowerL2; final compares equally tuned procedures
regularization.no_expansion_case: no auto gain claim; retain untouched B

customer_holdout.exclude: union ALL v1 sampled/train Q plus all v2 supervised query IDs; include reconstructible Aug05 pilot cohort if not exported
customer_holdout.reservation: past-only eligibility+hash ordering; reserve concrete IDs before any test-target access; historical global counts may include their past
customer_holdout.strict_boundary: no test Y, target counts/coverage or labeled cache until concrete new decision lock
customer_holdout.label: new customer holdout on previously observed calendar week, not independent temporal final
customer_holdout.primary: per-user meanAP across two modelseeds perarm, paired positive-user bootstrap2000/seed2026; gain iff lower95>0; no test-driven changes
customer_holdout.promotion_gate: Build test labels only if nonempty chosen expansion after symmetric L2 tuning has strictly positive point delta vs equally tuned M on BOTH development weeks; otherwise preserve untouched B and close this tranche without gain claim.
